source_evidence: B4-09 physical p6 Table7:1M nominal annual transport flow class; hypothetical already-captured source, not measured facility flow.
service_evidence: B4-06-S1 FiguresS9 MW-A allocations and TableS2 resource/readiness.
groups: r1-r4 vsr5-r8 disjoint; swapped route assignment is a structural control, not geography.
distance_evidence: B4-09 published shipping distance scenarios, not measured source-sink distances.
partial_objective: Injection minus IMO-default active-cycle WtW and uniform NETL-NGCC90/NVE2025-climate capture utility reference. Other terms are missing, not zero.
optimisation: Annual MILP with integer voyages; all source and resource groups coupled. Detailed fixed-plan reevaluation is not reoptimisation.
source_topology: Common capture stream split between two dedicated route export tanks/loading berths. Separate receiving terminals. Sum scheduled capture rates never exceeds common potential; unused share is not adaptively reassigned.
fleet_controls: Published annual fleet reference and one added vessel per assigned route; capital/idle penalties remain missing.
blank_semantics: Blank allocation annotations mean no reported allocation; assigning no exogenous service in this proxy does not establish geological zero capacity.
